method_expansion: Data-Consistent Information-Regularized reconstruction of wall-normal heat flux

scientific_role.observed_MV15A_failure: SITR-QY assigned at most 0.223603 percent weight to Raw B1 and remained 1.818595 times the paired Raw B10 q_y error at kn0p1_u400
mechanistic_diagnosis: the MV9 Mamba primary-condition q_y error contains a dominant spatial-mean offset
Raw B1 preserves spatial mean and scale but is dominated by spatial sampling noise
the radial MV15A selector grouped the DC mode with other modes and collapsed the complete Raw-B1 correction branch
the one-block information limit at U=400 remains unresolved
scientific_role.purpose: separate correctable extrapolation bias from a true sampling-budget limit before spending compute on new DSMC

budget_contract.source: the ten recursively verified additive B1 blocks already assembled by MV9 for every seed
budget_contract.construction: average consecutive nonoverlapping finalized B1 input fields within a seed
budget_contract.paired_comparator: exact MV9 Raw B10 field obtained by finalizing the merged additive accumulators once

selection_contract.signal_estimator: positive matching-group cross-seed DCT cross-spectrum recomputed separately for every disjoint budget
selection_contract.budget_noise_estimator: one-half the matching-group squared DCT difference between independent development seeds, recomputed separately for B1, B2, B3, and B5
selection_contract.budget_reliability: R_B(k)=S_B(k)/(S_B(k)+N_B(k)) using the empirical budget-specific spectra

data_consistency_contract.trusted_mode_rule: W_B(k)=strength*R_B(k) when R_B(k)>=threshold and zero otherwise
data_consistency_contract.DC_rule: W_B(0,0)=1 exactly for every budget and every condition
data_consistency_contract.interpretation: a hard observation-consistency projection, not a Fourier-law heat-flux closure

control_contract.condition_only_interpretation: tests whether condition metadata rather than the indexed DSMC observation explains the result
control_contract.permutation_control: cyclically exchange the Raw-Bn observation between legacy conditions while retaining Mamba output and condition identity
control_contract.same_condition_mean_control: the legacy target itself is a leave-one-seed-out same-condition mean; it is an oracle reference construction and cannot support an observation-driven claim

analysis_contract.authorization_rule: all budget-specific gates and all integrity gates must pass before a separately locked fresh campaign
analysis_contract.failure_rule: return the full budget ladder and error decomposition without retuning on legacy labels
